title: 屋外用壁掛け時計
description: 保護リム、目盛、固定された針、背面取付金具を備える無銘の静的壁掛け時計。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: A static unbranded exterior wall clock with protective bezel, tick marks, fixed hands and rear mounting hardware. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
